# CLAUDE.md This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository. ## What this is Korean college-admissions (수능 / 내신) study-planning SaaS. One codebase, **two brands** served by domain: `LearnPath AI` (B2C, students) and `IDA 스터디랩` (B2B, academies/학원). The product generates AI study plans, tracks daily execution, runs an AI photo-tutor (조교), and reports to parents. Stack: **Next.js 15 (App Router) · React 19 · TypeScript (strict) · Supabase (Postgres + Auth) · Anthropic Claude · Tailwind**, deployed on **Vercel** (region `icn1`) with **Vercel Cron**. Code, comments, prompts, UI, and commit messages are in **Korean** — match that. ## Test / demo accounts (로컬 live 검증용) 로컬 dev(`npm run dev`)로 쓰기 흐름을 직접 검증할 때 쓰는 계정. 공통 비밀번호 `idademo2026!` - 학생(student): `dohyun@ida-demo.kr` - 학원장(academy-admin): `director@ida-demo.kr` ## Branch workflow (중요) > **🚧 Milestone landscape (2026-07-26).** M4.7·M4.8 have **landed on `main`** — `feat/m4.7-design` (3 unique commits, 63 behind) and `feat/m4.8-beta` (0 unique, 27 behind) are dead branches; do not base or target work on them. **The default base for all non-M5 work is `main`.** The one live integration branch is **`feat/m5-innovation`** (445 commits ahead of `main`, 22 behind — *not* a superset), and it is **owned by another session**: don't commit or push to it directly — M5 work goes through PRs targeting it. Two come straight from the team's onboarding brief. 1. **D-day truth — never hardcode a date.** All 수능 D-day / 대입 학년도 logic must go through the functions in `lib/exam-calendar.ts` — `getSuneungDday(today)`, `getSuneungDdayForStudentType(type, today)` (auto-maps 고1=2029 / 고2=2028 / 고3·N수=2027 학년도), `getCurrentExamSchedule()`, `getCurrentPhase()`. A past hardcoded date caused the D-day to silently drift — do not reintroduce literal dates in feature code. Likewise, 학년 ↔ 대입연도 ↔ 등급제 ↔ 목표대학 labels come **only** from `lib/grade-system.ts` `gradeContext(type)`. 2. **Exam-bank copyright — never store full problem text.** The ~20k past-exam items (`past_exam_problems`, `lib/exam-bank.ts`) store only a one-line "what type of question" summary. Do **not** persist 문항 전문 / 지문 / 선택지. See `docs/runbooks/exam-ingest-runbook.md`. 3. **LLM proposes content, the server lays out the timetable.** In `generate-plan`, never trust the model to place meals/breaks or avoid overlaps — the deterministic post-processing (`buildMealBreakRows`, `splitStudyAroundBlocks`, `resolveOverlaps`) is the source of truth for the schedule grid. 4. **Server-only secrets stay server-only.** `lib/anthropic.ts`, `supabaseAdmin`, and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (no `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix) must never be imported or exposed in `'use client'` files. ## Commands ```bash npm run dev # Next dev server — `next dev -p 3001` (localhost:3001, not 3000) npm run build # Production build — ALSO the type-check gate (Next 15 fails build on TS errors) npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck # Faster standalone type check npm run lint # eslint . (flat config, eslint.config.mjs — not `next lint`, removed in Next 16) npm test # vitest run — unit tests in tests/*.test.ts (node env, no live APIs) npm run test:watch npx vitest run tests/exam-bank.test.ts # single test file npx vitest run -t "부분 문자열" # single test by name npm run test:hallucination # tests/hallucination-live.test.ts — hits REAL Claude/Supabase, needs env, costs tokens npm run ingest # scripts/ingest/ingest-exams.ts — exam-bank loader (scripts/ is gitignored, local-only) ``` There is no migration runner — see DB section. **There is no CI gate. Verification is local, and it is on you.** `gh workflow list` advertises `CI (타입·빌드·테스트 하드 게이트)` and `PR 분류·머지 게이트`, but **neither workflow file exists on any branch** — they are orphaned registrations that can never run. The only real workflows are `board-pages.yml`, `issue-status-labels.yml`, `pr-review-dispatch.yml`. So nothing automatically type-checks, builds, or tests a PR: run `npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` + `npm test` + `npm run lint` yourself before pushing. **Red PR checks are infrastructure, not code.** Two known non-defects: the `Vercel` check fails with "GitHub couldn't verify an account for the commit" (commits authored as `Validation Bot `), and Actions jobs fail in ~2s with **zero steps executed** (org-level runner/billing, never the diff). Don't chase these, and don't treat them as a merge blocker. ## Architecture — the parts that span files ### Three Supabase client surfaces (do not cross them) - `lib/supabase.ts`: `createBrowserSupabase()` — **singleton** browser client for `'use client'` files (multiple instances break sessions). Also exports `supabaseAdmin` — **service-role, bypasses RLS, API routes only**. - `lib/supabase-server.ts`: `createServerSupabase()` — cookie-session client for RSC / Route Handlers / Server Actions. Uses `next/headers`, so **never import it from a client file**. - **Two authz layers, know which one actually fires.** Postgres RLS *is* defined (`lib/schema.sql` + ~43 `sql/pN_*.sql`) encoding the "삼중 패턴" — three access paths: student-own / parent-read-linked / academy-admin. BUT **131 of the 152** API routes use the service-role `supabaseAdmin` client, which **bypasses RLS**; exactly 1 route uses the cookie-bound `createServerSupabase`. So for nearly all server traffic the operative gate is the **application-level `assertStudentAccess` in `lib/auth.ts`** (which re-implements the same three paths in TS), not RLS. RLS is defense-in-depth for any direct anon/authenticated client access. Treat `supabaseAdmin` as all-powerful and always gate it behind `requireUser()` + an access check. ### Auth & access control - `middleware.ts` is the first gate: redirects unauthenticated **page** requests to `/login`, returns `401` JSON for **API** requests. Public API prefixes: `/api/auth/register`, `/api/cron/`. It also: rewrites `/` → `/ida` for IDA hosts, self-heals corrupted refresh tokens (clears `sb-*` cookies instead of throwing), and enforces the **demo account read-only guard** (blocks all mutating methods with 403). - `lib/auth.ts` is the per-route gate. Standard pattern inside a Route Handler: ```ts try { const user = await requireUser(); await assertStudentAccess(user.id, student_id, 'write'); // 'read' | 'write' | 'parent_write' // ... } catch (e) { return authErrorResponse(e); } // maps AuthError → NextResponse ``` - Roles: `student | parent | teacher | admin` (on `users.role`) **plus** `academy_admins` (학원장 — scoped to their academy's students). `assertStudentAccess` resolves all of: self, linked parent (`parent_links`), global admin/teacher, and academy admin. Use `requireAdmin` / `requireAdminOrTeacher` for global-role-only actions. ### Claude / AI - `lib/anthropic.ts`: server-only client. `MODELS.FAST` = `claude-haiku-4-5` (plans, feedback, anomaly checks), `MODELS.SMART` = `claude-sonnet-4-6` (parent reports, strategy). Never import into a client file. - AI endpoints live under `app/api/ai/*`. The centerpiece is **`lib/generate-plan.ts` (~2,600 lines)** — the route (`app/api/ai/generate-plan/route.ts`) is a 16-line thin wrapper around it. Inside: a long Korean "8-year tuition tutor" system prompt, **fingerprint-based plan caching** in `study_plans` (regenerates only on `force_regenerate` or input-fingerprint change, not on a timer), and **deterministic server-side post-processing** of the LLM output (meal/break placement, sleep buffers, overlap resolution — the model is not trusted to lay out the timetable). - Wrap LLM endpoints in `rateLimit(key, limit, windowMs)` from `lib/rate-limit.ts` (in-memory, per serverless instance — a first line of defense against cost blowups, not a hard limit). - LLM output shown to students is sanitized via `lib/coach-text.ts` (strips markdown, protects math). Behavior is pinned by `tests/coach-text.test.ts` and the live `tests/hallucination-live.test.ts`. ### Database & migrations (manual, ordered) - `lib/schema.sql` is the base schema. `sql/p0_*.sql … p138_*.sql` are **phased migrations applied by hand in the Supabase SQL Editor, in number order**. `sql/demo_*.sql` seed demo/B2B-pitch data. There is **no automated migration tool** — applying them is a manual deploy step. - **Picking a new migration number: check every unmerged remote branch, not just `origin/main`.** The number is a global ordering slot, so a branch that also claims it collides on merge (today `p132`/`p133` had to be renumbered to `p137`/`p138` after colliding with `feat/m5-innovation`). Run `git fetch --all` then scan `git ls-tree -r --name-only sql/` across live branches before choosing. - **⚠️ Merging `feat/m5-innovation` into `main` requires renumbering first.** 12 numbers (`p88 p92 p102 p103 p104 p105 p108 p110 p111 p112 p113 p124`) hold **different migrations on each side**. Since application order is manual and number-driven, merging as-is breaks the ordering immediately — renumber the M5 side before the merge. - `types/index.ts` mirrors the DB **1:1**. Adding/altering a column means editing `schema.sql` (or a new `pN_*.sql`) **and** `types/index.ts` together. - Known footgun: a feature can ship working code while its migration is unapplied in production (e.g. a `CHECK` constraint that rejects new enum values), surfacing as "저장 실패". When a write fails in prod, suspect an unapplied migration first. See `README.md` for the canonical `students_type_check` (`highschool/nsu` → `high1/high2/high3/nsu`) example. ### Dual-brand (host-based) - `lib/brand.ts` resolves the brand from the request host. `NEXT_PUBLIC_IDA_HOSTS` (comma-separated) lists IDA domains; everything else is LearnPath. `withAcademyName()` does per-academy white-labeling. The backend/DB is shared — only front-end branding and the home landing differ. ### Domain model (Korean admissions) - Student `type`: `high1 | high2 | high3 | nsu`. Grading splits on this: **5등급제** for 고1·2 (2022 개정 교육과정 / 2028 수능 개편 generation) vs **9등급제** for 고3·N수. - `lib/grade-system.ts` is the single source of truth for 학년 ↔ 대입 학년도 ↔ 등급제 ↔ 목표대학 labels (고1=2029, 고2=2028, 고3·N수=2027). Use `gradeContext(type)` / `goalUniversityLabel(code)` everywhere rather than re-deriving these mappings. ### Cron - `vercel.json` schedules: `study-reminders` (every minute → web-push for tasks starting soon), `parent-reports` (weekly Mon / monthly 1st). Cron Route Handlers self-authenticate: preview·production에서는 `Authorization: Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}`가 필수이고, `vercel-cron` user-agent 폴백은 명시적 local development(`NODE_ENV=development` 및 로컬 `VERCEL_ENV`)에서만 허용된다 — the middleware lets `/api/cron/*` through unauthenticated by design. ### App surfaces `app/` uses the `(auth)` route group for login/signup. Role-oriented areas: `/today`, `/roadmap`, `/onboarding` (student); `/parent`; `/admin`, `/academy-admin` (operators); `/settings`; `/ta` (photo-question 조교); `/diagnostics`; `/ida` (IDA landing). `components/` is organized by the same domains. ## Environment Copy `.env.local.example` → `.env.local`.
